get_mws_kyl_indicators.name: Get MWS KYL Indicators
get_mws_kyl_indicators.description: Returns micro-watershed indicators covering rainfall and water balance, cropping and drought, NREGA works, land-cover change, restoration opportunities, groundwater and aquifer status, terrain, soil properties, vegetation, facilities, surface-water bodies, and fire activity.

aquifer_class.description: Class of the principal aquifer associated with the micro-watershed: 0 = Hard Rock and 1 = Alluvial.

area_protection.description: Area identified as suitable for protection under the restoration-opportunity classification.

area_wide_scale_restoration.description: Area identified as suitable for wide-scale restoration. In the WRI Restoration Opportunities Atlas, this generally refers to areas with tree-canopy cover density below 40%.

avg_double_cropped.description: Average annual percentage of total cropped area classified as double-cropped, calculated from the annual double-cropped areas and total cropped area.

avg_kharif_rainfall.description: Average rainfall during the Kharif season across the available years.

avg_kharif_surface_water_mws.description: Average Kharif surface-water area as a percentage of the total mapped surface-water-body area, averaged across the available years.

avg_number_dry_spell.description: Average count of dry-spell events per year, calculated from the source layer’s four-week dry-spell fields.

avg_precipitation.description: Average annual precipitation across the micro-watershed over the available years.

avg_rabi_surface_water_mws.description: Average Rabi surface-water area as a percentage of the total mapped surface-water-body area, averaged across the available years.

avg_runoff.description: Average annual runoff across the micro-watershed over the available years.

avg_single_cropped.description: Average annual percentage of total cropped area classified as single-cropped, calculated from the annual single-cropped areas and total cropped area.

avg_triple_cropped.description: Average annual percentage of total cropped area classified as triple-cropped, calculated from the annual triple-cropped areas and total cropped area.

avg_wsr_ratio_kharif.description: Kharif water-surface ratio calculated from summed Kharif surface-water area and summed Kharif cropped area across the available years, multiplied by 100 and divided by the number of Kharif surface-water-area columns.

avg_wsr_ratio_rabi.description: Rabi water-surface ratio calculated from summed Rabi surface-water area and summed Rabi cropped area across the available years, multiplied by 100 and divided by the number of Rabi surface-water-area columns.

avg_wsr_ratio_zaid.description: Zaid water-surface ratio calculated from summed Zaid surface-water area and summed Zaid cropped area across the available years, multiplied by 100 and divided by the number of Zaid surface-water-area columns.

avg_zaid_surface_water_mws.description: Average Zaid surface-water area as a percentage of the total mapped surface-water-body area, averaged across the available years.

canal_available.description: Indicates whether a canal feature is mapped within the micro-watershed: true if present, false otherwise.

cropping_area.description: Total cropped area in the micro-watershed, based on the annual cropping-intensity data.

cropping_intensity_avg.description: Mean annual cropping-intensity value across the available years; it represents the intensity of cultivation across crop cycles.

cropping_intensity_trend.description: Trend in annual cropping intensity, encoded as 1 for increasing, -1 for decreasing, and 0 for no trend.

cropping_to_shrub_area.description: Area of cropland that changed to scrub or shrubland in the land-cover change layer.

decrease_in_tree_cover.description: Total area classified as deforestation in the overall land-cover change output.

degradation_cropping_intensity.description: Area affected by a decline in cropping intensity, including double-to-single, triple-to-double, and triple-to-single cropping transitions.

degradation_in_forests.description: Area of forest degradation reported by the overall tree-change layer.

degradation_land_area.description: Combined area of cropland changing to barren land or scrubland and land changing from higher to lower cropping intensity.

distance_to_bank.description: Distance value in kilometres calculated from the bank-mitra, bank-branch, and ATM distance fields in the facilities-proximity data.

drainage_density.description: Drainage-line length per square kilometre within the micro-watershed, as reported by the drainage-density layer.

drought_category.description: Drought category based on the number of years in which moderate- and severe-drought weeks total at least five: 0 = no such years, 1 = one such year, and 2 = two or more such years.

factory_csr.description: Flag indicating whether the factory/CSR layer contains a record for the micro-watershed: 1 = present, 0 = not present.

fire_count_per_year.description: Fire detections per year for the micro-watershed, as reported by the forest-fire layer.

forest_to_farm.description: Area that changed from forest to farmland in the deforestation change-detection layer.

green_credit.description: Flag indicating whether the green-credit layer contains a record for the micro-watershed: 1 = present, 0 = not present.

increase_canopy_density_height.description: Percentage value for improvement in canopy density or height from the overall tree-change layer.

increase_in_tree_cover.description: Total area classified as afforestation in the land-cover change output.

lcw_conflict.description: Flag indicating whether the land-cover/water-conflict layer contains a record for the micro-watershed: 1 = conflict record present, 0 = none present.

lulc_crop.description: Percentage of the micro-watershed area classified as cropped land, calculated from total cropped area divided by micro-watershed area.

lulc_forest.description: Percentage of the micro-watershed area under tree/forest cover, based on the mean mapped tree/forest area across the available LULC years.

lulc_plain_category.description: Terrain-cluster name assigned to the plain terrain portion of the micro-watershed.

lulc_shrub.description: Percentage of the micro-watershed area under shrub/scrub cover, based on the mean mapped shrub/scrub area across the available LULC years.

lulc_slope_category.description: Terrain-cluster name assigned to the sloping terrain portion of the micro-watershed.

max_drought_weeks.description: Sum of the maximum number of moderate-drought weeks and maximum number of severe-drought weeks recorded in the Kharif drought data.

max_monsoon_onset_day.description: Latest monsoon-onset day number within the calendar year (1–366), across the available years.

mean_annual_delta_g_mm.description: Mean annual Delta G, representing the change in groundwater storage expressed as an equivalent water depth.

mean_elevation.description: Mean elevation of the micro-watershed from the digital elevation model, in metres.

mean_kharif_water_surface_area.description: Mean mapped surface-water area during Kharif across the available years.

min_monsoon_onset_day.description: Earliest monsoon-onset day number within the calendar year (1–366), across the available years.

mining.description: Flag indicating whether the mining layer contains a record for the micro-watershed: 1 = present, 0 = not present.

mws_intersect_swb.description: List of surface-water bodies intersecting the micro-watershed. Each entry includes the water-body ID, name when available, latitude, and longitude.

swbId.description: Unique identifier of the intersecting surface-water body.

swbName.description: Name of the surface-water body, when available; may be an empty string.

latitude.description: Latitude of the surface-water body in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of the surface-water body in decimal degrees.

mws_intersect_villages.description: List of village IDs for villages that intersect the micro-watershed.

nitrogen_levels.description: Median estimated soil nitrogen content, in kilograms per hectare, from the soil-health layer.

nrega_irrigation.description: Total number of NREGA works classified as irrigation on farms across the available years.

nrega_plantations.description: Total number of NREGA works classified as plantations across the available years.

nrega_swc.description: Total number of NREGA works classified as soil and water conservation across the available years.

organic_carbon.description: Median soil organic-carbon content over cropping pixels, expressed as a percentage, from the soil-health layer.

organic_carbon_tree_cover.description: Median organic-carbon content over tree and shrub/scrub covers, expressed as a percentage, from the OpenLandMap Organic Carbon layer.

phosphoros_levels.description: Median estimated soil phosphorus content, in kilograms per hectare, from the soil-health layer.

potassium_levels.description: Median estimated soil potassium content, in kilograms per hectare, from the soil-health layer.

reduction_canopy_density_height.description: Percentage value for degradation in canopy density or height from the overall tree-change layer.

reduction_in_shrubland_cover.description: Area of change in shrubland cover reported by the shrub-change layer.

relative_mean_elevation.description: Difference in metres between the micro-watershed mean elevation and the mean elevation across the micro-watersheds of a tehsil.

relief.description: Elevation range in metres within the micro-watershed, calculated as maximum elevation minus minimum elevation.

river_available.description: Indicates whether a river feature is mapped within the micro-watershed: true if present, false otherwise.

shg_penetration.description: SHG penetration indicator value from the Antyodaya data for villages intersecting the micro-watershed.

shrub_trend.description: Trend in shrub cover from the NDVI layer, encoded as 1 for increasing, -1 for decreasing, and 0 for no trend.

soge_class.description: Stage of groundwater extraction: 0 = Safe, 1 = Semi-Critical, 2 = Critical, 3 = Over Exploited, and 4 = Not Assessed.

soil_drainage.description: Soil drainage class derived from the mapped soil drainage description: 0 = excessively or somewhat excessively drained, 1 = well or moderately well drained, 2 = poorly or very poorly drained, and 3 = imperfectly drained.

soil_ph.description: Topsoil pH value, indicating soil acidity or alkalinity.

soil_texture.description: Soil texture class derived from subsoil texture: 0 = sandy textures, 1 = silt/loam textures, 2 = clay-loam textures, and 3 = clay textures.

terraincluster_id.description: Identifier of the terrain cluster assigned to the micro-watershed.

total_nrega_assets.description: Total number of NREGA works recorded for the micro-watershed across all included work categories and years.

tree_cover_area.description: Area under tree cover reported by the overall tree-change layer.

trees_in_forest_fringe_loss.description: Area of tree loss within the forest-fringe zone.

trees_in_forest_loss.description: Area of tree loss within the micro-watershed.

trees_in_grassland_loss.description: Area of tree loss within the tree-in-shrub-tree zone reported by the tree-in-grassland layer.

trend_annual_rainfall.description: Annual rainfall trend from the Mann–Kendall test, encoded as 1 for increasing, -1 for decreasing, and 0 for no trend.

trend_g.description: Groundwater-storage trend from the annual hydrological time series, evaluated with the Mann–Kendall test and encoded as 1 for increasing, -1 for decreasing, and 0 for no trend.

trend_swb.description: Trend in annual total surface-water area from the surface-water-bodies time series, encoded as 1 for increasing, -1 for decreasing, and 0 for no trend using the Mann–Kendall test.

upstream_mws.description: Number of upstream micro-watersheds connected to and draining into this micro-watershed.

urbanization_area.description: Total area classified as urbanization in the change-detection layer, including transitions from barren/shrub, tree/farm, or water to built-up land.

error_message.description: Error details when the request fails; null when there is no error.

status.description: Indicates whether the API request succeeded.

get_active_locations_api.name: Get Active Locations
get_active_locations_api.description: Returns the states, districts, and blocks or tehsils available for selection, including their identifiers and display labels.

locations[].description: List of available states and their nested districts and blocks/tehsils.

block_id.description: Identifier of a block or tehsil.
Identifier of the block or tehsil.

label.description: Display name of the block or tehsil.

tehsil_id.description: Identifier of the tehsil, when provided.

label.description: Display name shown in the location selector.

value.description: Value used by the application for the location option, when provided.

location_field_hints.description: Field hints describing the location fields and nested hierarchy.

blocks.description: Hint indicating the blocks/tehsils nested under a district.

district.description: Hint indicating the districts nested under a state.

label.description: Hint indicating that the field contains a display name.

value.description: Hint indicating the value used for a UI list option.

error_message.description: Error details when the request fails; null when there is no error.

status.description: Indicates whether the API request succeeded.

get_admin_details_by_latlon_api.name: Get Admin Details by Latitude and Longitude
get_admin_details_by_latlon_api.description: Returns the state, district, and tehsil containing the supplied latitude and longitude.

District.description: Name of the district containing the supplied coordinate.

State.description: Name of the state containing the supplied coordinate.

Tehsil.description: Name of the tehsil containing the supplied coordinate.

error_message.description: Error details when the request fails; null when there is no error.

status.description: Indicates whether the API request succeeded.

get_generated_layer_urls_api.name: Get Generated Layer URLs
get_generated_layer_urls_api.description: Returns the geospatial layers available for a micro-watershed, including each layer’s name, type, service URL, version, style, and source asset path when available.

layer_field_units.description: Field hints describing the meaning or expected format of layer metadata fields.

dataset_name.description: Hint indicating a human-readable dataset name.

gee_asset_path.description: Hint indicating an Earth Engine asset ID or null.

layer_url.description: Hint indicating a GeoServer WFS/WCS URL.

style_url.description: Hint indicating a style URL or an empty value.

layers[].description: List of generated layers. Each item describes one available layer.

gee_asset_path.description: Google Earth Engine asset ID or source data path associated with the layer; may be null or a local path.

layer_name.description: Internal layer name used by the geospatial service.

layer_type.description: Layer geometry/data type, such as vector, raster, point, or custom.

layer_url.description: URL used to access the layer through the relevant geospatial service.

style_url.description: URL of the layer style, or an empty string when no style URL is provided.

error_message.description: Error details when the request fails; null when there is no error.

status.description: Indicates whether the API request succeeded.

get_mws_report_api.name: Get MWS Report
get_mws_report_api.description: Returns the URL of the generated report for the requested micro-watershed and administrative location.

Mws_report_url.description: URL of the generated MWS report in HTML or PDF form.

report_field_hints.description: Field hints that describe the meaning of report response fields.

Mws_report_url.description: Semantic hint for the report URL field; identifies it as an MWS report URL.

error_message.description: Error details when the request fails; null when there is no error.

status.description: Indicates whether the API request succeeded.

get_mwsid_by_latlon_api.name: Get MWS ID by Latitude and Longitude
get_mwsid_by_latlon_api.description: Returns the micro-watershed identifier and its state, district, and tehsil for the supplied latitude and longitude.

District.description: Name of the district containing the coordinate.

State.description: Name of the state containing the coordinate.

Tehsil.description: Name of the tehsil or block containing the coordinate.

mws_field_hints.description: Field hints describing the MWS details.

Tehsil.description: Hint indicating a tehsil or block name.

error_message.description: Error details when the request fails; null when there is no error.

status.description: Indicates whether the API request succeeded.

get_village_geometries_api.name: Get Village Geometries
get_village_geometries_api.description: Returns village boundary geometries and village attributes in GeoJSON format.

coordinates.description: Nested coordinate arrays defining the geometry. Coordinates are longitude/latitude for the supplied EPSG:4326 example.

geometry_name.description: Name of the geometry field in the source service.

id.description: Feature identifier returned by the geospatial service.

numberMatched.description: Number of features matching the request.

numberReturned.description: Number of features returned in this response.

totalFeatures.description: Total number of features reported by the service.

type.description: GeoJSON object type; typically FeatureCollection for the top-level response and Feature for each item.

error_message.description: Error details when the request fails; null when there is no error.

status.description: Indicates whether the API request succeeded.

get_mws_time_series_api.name: Get MWS Time Series
get_mws_time_series_api.description: Returns fortnightly precipitation, evapotranspiration, and runoff values for a micro-watershed, with matching dates and units. These variables describe components of the water balance: precipitation minus runoff minus evapotranspiration.

data.description: Container for the API response data.

fortnight.description: Fortnightly time-series values for the micro-watershed. Each metric array aligns position-by-position with the time array.

time.description: Dates associated with the time-series values, formatted as ISO 8601 calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Values at the same array index in et, runoff, and precipitation correspond to this date.

fortnight_units.description: Units and temporal resolution for the fortnightly time series.

time.description: Format used for the dates in the time array.

time_step.description: Temporal resolution of the time-series data.

mws_id.description: Identifier of the micro-watershed for which the time series is returned.

error_message.description: Error details when the request fails; null when there is no error.

status.description: Indicates whether the API request succeeded.

get_mws_geometries_api.name: Get MWS Geometries
get_mws_geometries_api.description: Returns a micro-watershed boundary as GeoJSON geometry together with its unique identifier and administrative details.

data.description: Response data containing the micro-watershed details.

mws_geometry.description: Micro-watershed identifier, administrative names, and polygon geometry.

state.description: Name of the state containing the micro-watershed.

district.description: Name of the district containing the micro-watershed.

tehsil.description: Name of the tehsil or block containing the micro-watershed.

geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry describing the micro-watershed boundary.

type.description: GeoJSON geometry type, such as Polygon.

coordinates.description: Nested coordinate arrays for the polygon boundary. Each coordinate position is represented as [longitude, latitude].

error_message.description: Error details when the request fails; null when there is no error.

status.description: Indicates whether the API request succeeded.
